task_completion.description: The correct playback file 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-MotorImagery.txt' is selected in the OpenBCI GUI.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file selection dialog or the 'Playback File' path in the GUI shows 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-MotorImagery.txt'.

task_completion.description: The EMG widget is opened and visible in the GUI layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A widget titled 'EMG' is visible in one of the GUI panels.

task_completion.description: Channel 1 is active/enabled within the EMG widget settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the EMG widget, the toggle or indicator for Channel 1 (uV or bar graph) is active/colored.

task_completion.description: Channels 2 through 8 are disabled in the EMG widget to isolate Channel 1.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the EMG widget settings or channel selection, channels 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8 are toggled off or grayed out.

task_completion.description: The EMG threshold is adjusted above the baseline noise floor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The horizontal threshold line in the EMG widget is positioned above the resting signal level (noise floor) of the Channel 1 trace.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the OpenBCI GUI elements rather than just using terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor moving to and clicking GUI buttons, dropdowns, or toggles within the OpenBCI application.

integrity.description: The system is in a 'Streaming' or 'Playback' state showing live data movement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The time-series or EMG graphs show active waveform movement rather than a static, empty, or flat-lined display.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply overwrite a configuration file via terminal to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the manual selection of channels and threshold adjustment within the GUI interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target file is 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-MotorImagery.txt'. The EMG widget must be used. Channel 1 must be the ONLY active channel in the EMG widget (Channels 2-8 must be disabled). The threshold line in the EMG widget must be visibly higher than the resting signal amplitude to prevent false triggers.
